description: Revisit FF-output unions in a five-trial cross-tensor band
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,454 parameters at 99.210000%, a +0.210000-point margin. There have been 86 prior macro-attempts and 699 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0188/micro-0005 at 1,454/99.21%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0186/micro-0001, while the last FF-output failure was attempt-0174/micro-0001 pair 109/123 at 98.98%. That pair and seven earlier sensitive FF-output pairs are excluded. Hypothesis: 64 cross-tensor reductions and recovered margin reopen the next FF-output band. The helper adds one ordered eligible union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, five trials, or seven minutes. This is more informative than another longer QKV band because it tests whether reopening generalizes across tensors within the remaining macro budget.
summary: The five-trial FF-output revisit evaluated five ordered unions. Four qualified and reduced the frontier from 1,454 to 1,450 parameters; the fifth proposed 1,449, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 4 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used five official migrations/verifications over about 6m05s. Stop reason: first scored discard on the final scheduled trial.
